name: Multi-Sequence Cardiac MR Segmentation Challenge
description: The Multi-Sequence Cardiac MR Segmentation Challenge is a medical imaging benchmark for automated segmentation of ventricles and myocardium in late gadolinium enhancement cardiac MRI. It addresses challenging pathological myocardium boundaries and limited labeled data across sequences.
evaluation_method: Segmentation quality metrics such as Dice coefficient, often with per-structure and aggregate scores over cardiac MRI cases.
notes: Focused on late gadolinium enhancement CMR, where boundaries can be indistinguishable and labeled data are limited. The benchmark is challenge-style and image-sequence specific.
